title: Other screens showing a customer's term: plain name or (Inactive)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have customer A on Net 60, with an open invoice and an open work order 1, so customer A is on the report.
  • Then make sure Net 60 is deactivated.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports, A/R Aging Collection.
  2. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens.
  • Its "Credit term:" reads "Net 60" or "Net 60 (Inactive)", as the PO answers.

Step 2:

  • Where the customer's term shows on the work order, it reads as the PO answers.

The PRD names only the customer card, the Edit windows and the printed documents. Question 4 on Chris Ward's sheet (shared with him 23 Oct 2026) asks about the other screens; held until he answers.
